svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 210 x 34 mm from 2 mm sheet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 4.5 mm holes for the floor screws, 7 from each end, 17 from either

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay out on it, left to right: the 30 A main fuse holder, the 20 A DC

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: breaker, then the inverter relay with its 47 ohm pre-charge resistor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill each to its own holes, M4 or M3 with nyloc nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the floor between the inverter and the pack bay, two M4 button

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: heads from below with nyloc nuts on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All three parts must be rated 60 V DC or more; the fuse holder

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and fuse at least 1 kA breaking capacity.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 6 mm clear of the inverter and 14 mm clear of the runners.
